description: This file defines a Java servlet class `ModuleServlet` which handles HTTP requests for modules in the OpenMRS system. It retrieves module and servlet information from the URL, uses utility methods to find and delegate to sub-servlets, and includes an internal static implementation of `ServletConfig` to initialize loaded servlets.

classes.name: ModuleServlet
classes.description: A servlet that handles incoming HTTP requests targeting module-specific sub-servlets based on URL parsing, delegating requests to dynamically loaded servlets within the OpenMRS module framework.

methods.name: service
methods.description: Overrides HttpServlet's service method to process requests, extract module and servlet identifiers from URL, locate corresponding servlets, and delegate request handling.

methods.name: SimpleServletConfig
methods.description: Inner static class implementing ServletConfig interface, providing configuration details to dynamically loaded servlets.

methods.name: getServletName
methods.description: Returns the name of this servlet configuration.

methods.name: getServletContext
methods.description: Returns the ServletContext in which this servlet is running.

methods.name: getInitParameter
methods.description: Returns the initialization parameter for the given name, if available.

methods.name: getInitParameterNames
methods.description: Returns an enumeration of the names of the initialization parameters.
